protocol.status: Declared before calculating fee-checkpoint results; observation-definition sensitivity only
protocol.scope: Keep the original annual-endpoint MDD unchanged. Add known post-fee/pre-return wealth observations to the same executed static annual paths. Do not refit menus, targets, assignments, alpha or confidence conventions.

data.prior_exposure: Old V1 final data were previously seen; this is no fresh blind evaluation.

execution.policy: Existing annual restoration of all 232 fixed 5pp/exact-thirds targets
execution.initial_fee: Charged once under the existing exact transfer convention

definitions.price: P_0=1; P_t=product_{j=1}^t(1+inflation_j). Executed annual real wealth R_t=W_t/P_t already includes all actual fees.
definitions.annual_peak: M_(t-1)=max_{0<=j<=t-1} R_j, using the original annual endpoints.
definitions.post_fee_real: F_t=(W_(t-1)-C_t)/P_(t-1)=R_(t-1)-C_t/P_(t-1), before year-t returns and year-t inflation.
definitions.fee_checkpoint_mdd: D_feeobs=max(D_annual, max_{1<=t<=H}(1-F_t/M_(t-1))). Fees are nonnegative, so F_t cannot raise the existing annual running peak.
definitions.interpretation: MDD at annual endpoints plus known fee observations. It is a finer observation lower bound for an unknown continuous path, not measured intrayear or continuous-time MDD.
definitions.no_double_fee: Only add an observation to an already executed path. Do not subtract a fee again from annual/terminal wealth, alter growth or alter cumulative fees.
definitions.risk_event: MDD > L + 1e-12, preserving the original numerical equality convention.

comparisons: All 232 candidates at the five fixed client H,L events, with exact counts, sample denominator, newly flagged paths, MDD increment, expected excess and CVaR90 changes.
Every product-client pair in all nine frozen full-development primary menus; retain product identity, original chosen flag and assignment. Do not classify by refitting the observation definition.
The 600 original alpha10/risk_only primary OOF client-path rows. Preserve the recorded fold target and assignment; Review financial fields stay null and coverage denominators remain explicit.
unchanged: Annual-endpoint risk definition in the original study

checks: Reproduced annual paths and every cached annual metric/fee/moved/trade-fraction value at all five H before assessing sensitivity.
D_feeobs >= D_annual; fee points do not create a new peak; expected excess and CVaR90 cannot decrease apart from numerical tolerance.
MDD increment is no greater than the largest real fee divided by the preceding annual peak. The proportional model also gives C/V <= c/(1+c).
Synthetic initial fee followed by a positive net annual gain: annual MDD zero but fee-observation MDD positive.
Synthetic annual path [100,90.01,110] with second-year fee .02: L=.10 changes from non-exceedance to exceedance.
Use the transaction-time P_(t-1), not P_t; adding observations cannot charge the fee twice.
protocol.inference: Descriptive definition sensitivity on reused development paths. No new risk certification, intrayear protection, policy selection, cost probe or menu replacement.
protocol.provenance: Record source and frozen-input hashes at start/end, guarded-development array hash, output hashes and the exact observation formula.

scope: Observation-definition sensitivity only; original annual MDD, strategies, assignments, growth and fees remain unchanged. Fee observations are not measured continuous/intrayear MDD.
